target_text: Japanese transport convoy and retiring bombardment force, after staging to Guadalcanal
source_locator: R2232: ch. 2, The Battle for Guadalcanal
notes: Craven and Cate, vol. IV, ch. 2: early on 14 November 1942 ten B-26s of the 70th Bombardment Squadron were sent across to Guadalcanal; the same passage describes the Henderson-based attacks on the convoy and retiring bombardment force that day. Target place Ironbottom Sound. Confidence 0.7. Base claim C13039 (14 November, Henderson) is in force.
